index.html.title: Mark Simonsen, CPA | Tax Planning & Property Review
index.html.description: Explore Mark Simonsen’s AE Tax Advisors profile, planning resources and property study questions. Review scope and fees before requesting a discovery call.
index.html.heading: Prepare for a property or business planning discussion
index.html.body:
Define the decision first: a rental-property review, a study proposal, owner compensation or ongoing business planning. Compare real estate advisory, business-owner support and published scope and fees.

Bring the relevant financials, entity information, property schedules and decision deadline. Request an AE discovery call and confirm the professionals assigned to your engagement.

blog/cost-segregation-montana/index.html.title: Montana Cost Segregation Study Review | AE Tax
blog/cost-segregation-montana/index.html.description: Montana property owners: prepare study records, compare cost segregation scope and fees, and discuss preparer coordination with AE Tax Advisors.
blog/cost-segregation-montana/index.html.heading: Compare a study proposal before commissioning the work
blog/cost-segregation-montana/index.html.body:
Bring the property address, closing records, acquisition and placed-in-service dates, improvement invoices and prior depreciation schedules. Ask how the report will reconcile to your records and who will implement it on the return.

Review published study pricing and scope, then discuss your property study questions. A general property guide does not establish your usable tax benefit.
